label: Women's ODI
methodology: Replay 100 completed first innings. At each checkpoint, predict final score from match state without future data. Fielding ratings from Cricsheet ball-by-ball data (5094 players, 110 teams).
summary: Across 400 predictions the model has an MAE of 36.0 runs and RMSE of 48.3 runs. Bias is +2.5 runs (the model overshoots on average). The predicted range captures the actual score 53.5% of the time with an average range width of 64 runs. Error by final score bucket: low-scoring (<160): 43.6 runs MAE, mid-range (160–200): 18.1 runs MAE, high-scoring (200+): 38.8 runs MAE. Predictions are least accurate at the 10-over checkpoint (MAE 45.0 runs) and most accurate at 40 overs (MAE 24.5 runs).
